info.title: IMP REST API
info.description: REST endpoints of the IMP backend. GraphQL covers entity CRUD; REST covers agent runs, media, files, and system utilities. All requests require authentication unless the agent is public.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of your IMP backend. Self-hosted deployments typically run on port 9001.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Organisation API key. Format: `sk_<secret>/<keyname>` — the secret portion, a literal slash, and the human-readable key name. The header `exulu-api-key` is accepted as an alias. A `Bearer ` prefix is tolerated and stripped. Keys with an agent scope are only valid for the scoped agent instance.

bearer.description: NextAuth session JWT (HS256, signed with `NEXTAUTH_SECRET`). This is the token the IMP frontend uses automatically.

message.description: Human-readable error message (alternate key used on some endpoints).

UIMessage.description: An AI SDK UIMessage object. Contains an `id` string, a `role` string (`user` | `assistant` | `system` | `tool`), and a `parts` array of part objects (text, tool-call, tool-result, image, etc.).

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: Endpoints for running, compacting, and querying agent instances.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Endpoints for managing files attached to agent sessions.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Transcription, speech synthesis, and image generation.

tags.name: Budgets
tags.description: LiteLLM tag-budget management for users, roles, teams, projects, agents, and routines. Access requires `super_admin` or a role with `budget_management` write scope.

tags.name: Skills
tags.description: Skills are versioned bundles of files (markdown, scripts, assets) mounted into the agent sandbox. These endpoints manage the skill registry and individual skill files.

tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: Uppy-compatible S3 companion routes for single-part and multipart file uploads. Accept the standard API key. The `internal-key` header (set to `INTERNAL_SECRET`) is accepted only on `/s3/delete`, `/s3/download`, `/s3/list`, and `/s3/object` — it does **not** work on `/s3/sign` or the `/s3/multipart` routes.

tags.name: Compliance
tags.description: GDPR / DSGVO operator endpoints for data-subject access (export) and erasure. Both require `super_admin`.

tags.name: Artifacts
tags.description: Shareable artifact links — create, list, and revoke share links for files stored in S3.

get.description: Returns whether the request is authenticated. Does not require authentication to call — unauthenticated callers receive `{ authenticated: false }` rather than a 401. Useful for verifying credentials before a chat session.

Returns the platform's active theme (light and dark colour maps) as stored in `platform_configurations`. Returns empty `light`/`dark` objects when the deployment is not licensed for custom branding or when no theme has been configured. No authentication is required.

Returns selected `ExuluApp` configuration options needed by the frontend: auth mode, feature entitlements, MCP status, telemetry, file-upload endpoint, worker health, LiteLLM status, and Recall integration. No authentication is required.

post.description: Sends a message to an agent instance and returns the response. When the `stream` header is `true`, the response is an AI SDK UIMessage stream over SSE (text/event-stream); otherwise a sync JSON response is returned. The agent's `rights_mode` controls whether an API key or session JWT is required — public agents allow unauthenticated calls. An agent-scoped API key is only valid for its bound agent instance. Supply the `session` header to persist messages to a session.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Set to `true` to receive a streaming SSE response (AI SDK UIMessage stream). Omit or set to `false` for a synchronous JSON response.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Agent session ID. When provided, message history is loaded from and saved to the session. The caller must have write access to the session.

parameters.name: x-exulu-model-override
parameters.description: LiteLLM model ID to use for this request, overriding the model configured on the agent. Only accepted when the resolved model is permitted for the calling user.

message.description: The user message to send. Used when `session` is set or when sending a single message without history.

messages.description: Full conversation history. When provided without a `session` header and without a `message` field, the last element is used as the current message and the rest as prior context.

customInstructions.description: Additional system instructions appended to the agent's base instructions for this run only.

disabledTools.description: Tool IDs to exclude from this run, even if enabled on the agent.

disabledSkills.description: Skill IDs to exclude from this run.

approvedTools.description: Tool call IDs that the user has pre-approved for execution without a confirmation prompt.

parts.text: What is the capital of France?

200.description: Successful response. When `stream: true` the body is an AI SDK UIMessage stream (text/event-stream); each line is a server-sent event carrying a UIMessage part or finish chunk. When `stream: false` the body is a sync JSON object returned by `provider.generateSync`.

schema.description: AI SDK UIMessage stream. Lines are SSE events; each event carries a serialised UIMessage part (text delta, tool-call, tool-result, finish-step, finish). The final `finish` event includes token usage in its `messageMetadata`.
The assistant's final text as a JSON-encoded string.

400.description: Missing or invalid request parameters (missing instance, missing model on agent, bad scope, request validation error).

401.description: Authentication failed or caller lacks read access to the agent or write access to the session.

403.description: Model not permitted for the calling user or agent-scoped key used against a different agent.

404.description: Agent with the given `instance` ID not found.

413.description: Context window is full and compaction is required before the next message can be sent.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL — streaming
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST https://your-imp-host/agents/litellm/run/d4f7a2e1-6c3b-4a9e-8f21-0b5c9d7e3a10 \
  -H "x-api-key: sk_abc123.../my-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "stream: true" \
  -H "session: e7c3b8a2-0d4f-4b1e-9c72-3a6d5e8f1b20" \
  -d '{"message":{"id":"msg_01Ab","role":"user","parts":[{"type":"text","text":"Hello"}]}}'

post.description: Summarises older messages in the session into a compact checkpoint message, reducing the context window footprint. Returns a 409 if a response is currently streaming for the session. Returns a 422 if the session history is too short to benefit from compaction. The `x-exulu-model-override` header is accepted to choose the summarisation model.

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Agent session ID whose history should be compacted.

parameters.name: x-exulu-model-override
parameters.description: LiteLLM model ID to use for summarisation, overriding the agent's configured model.

steer.description: Optional freeform instruction appended to the compaction prompt to guide what the summary should emphasise.

200.description: Compaction result including the checkpoint message.

schema.description: Result returned by compactSession — includes the generated checkpoint message and the number of messages replaced.

400.description: Missing session header, missing instance, or agent has no model configured.

401.description: Authentication failed or caller lacks access to the agent or session.

403.description: Model not permitted for the calling user.

409.description: A response is still streaming for this session.

422.description: Session history is too short to compact.

post.description: Generates up to three short follow-up prompts based on the most recent conversation exchange. Requires `suggestions_enabled` to be set on the agent; returns 400 otherwise. This call is stateless — it does not read from or write to a session. The agent's `rights_mode` controls whether authentication is required.

messages.description: The conversation history (at minimum the last user + assistant pair) to base suggestions on.

200.description: Array of up to three suggested follow-up strings.

suggestions: Can you break that down by region?
What were the main drivers of growth?
How does this compare to last year?

400.description: Missing `agentId`, empty `messages` array, suggestions not enabled on the agent, or no model configured.

401.description: Authentication failed or caller lacks read access to the agent.

403.description: Model not permitted for the calling user or agent-scoped key mismatch.

get.description: Lists all files stored in the session's S3 prefix, sorted most-recent first. Returns presigned download URLs for each file. Requires read access to the session and S3 file-upload configuration on the deployment.

401.description: Authentication failed or caller lacks read access to the session.

403.description: Caller does not have read access to the session.

500.description: File uploads not configured or S3 listing failed.

delete.description: Deletes a single file from the session's S3 prefix. The `key` query parameter must belong to the session prefix — the backend enforces a prefix check and returns 403 if it does not. Requires write access to the session.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Full S3 object key of the file to delete (as returned by the list endpoint).

401.description: Authentication failed or caller lacks write access to the session.

403.description: Key does not belong to this session.

post.description: Returns a presigned S3 PUT URL and the full S3 key for uploading a single file into the session's prefix. The caller should PUT the file bytes directly to `uploadUrl`, then call `/sessions/{sessionId}/files/sync-to-sandbox` with the returned `key`. Requires write access to the session.

filename.description: Desired filename. Path separators and `..` are rejected.

contentType.description: MIME type for the S3 object (e.g. `application/pdf`).

200.description: Presigned upload URL and the resulting S3 key.

key.description: Full S3 object key to pass to sync-to-sandbox.

400.description: Missing `filename` or `contentType`, or filename failed safety validation.

401.description: Authentication failed or caller lacks write access to the session.

post.summary: Sync an uploaded file into the sandbox
post.description: After a successful Uppy upload, call this endpoint with the S3 key to materialise the file in the agent's sandbox filesystem so the agent can read it on its next tool call. No-op if the sandbox is not currently active. Requires write access to the session and the key must belong to the session prefix.

key.description: Full S3 object key as returned by upload-sign.

401.description: Authentication failed or caller lacks write access to the session.

403.description: Key does not belong to this session's prefix.

get.description: Converts an Office binary file (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx, etc.) in the session's S3 prefix to PDF via LibreOffice and returns the PDF bytes. Results are cached by S3 ETag — subsequent requests for the same file version are served from disk. The JWT may be passed as an `?auth=` query parameter (instead of the `Authorization` header) so `<iframe>` elements can load the PDF directly. Requires read access to the session and the key must belong to the session prefix.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Full S3 object key of the Office file to convert.

parameters.name: auth
parameters.description: Bearer JWT as an alternative to the `Authorization` header. Use this when loading the PDF in an `<iframe>`.

200.description: PDF bytes of the converted file.

401.description: Authentication failed or caller lacks read access to the session.

403.description: Key does not belong to this session.

404.description: Source file not found in S3.

post.description: Transcribes an audio file using the Whisper model configured via `TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL`. Accepts multipart/form-data with a single `file` field; the MIME type must start with `audio/`. Maximum file size is 25 MB. Returns 503 when `EXULU_USE_LITELLM` or `TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL` are not set.

file.description: Audio file. MIME type must start with `audio/`. Maximum 25 MB.

language.description: Optional ISO 639-1 language hint (e.g. `de`). Without it, Whisper auto-detects the language.

example.text: The quarterly revenue increased by twelve percent year over year.

400.description: No file provided, unsupported MIME type, or upload failed.

503.description: Speech-to-text not enabled on this deployment, or the transcription service is not yet ready.

post.description: Converts text to speech using the model configured via `TTS_MODEL` and the voice from `TTS_VOICE`. Returns MP3 audio bytes (`audio/mpeg`). Input is capped at 4,000 characters. Returns 503 when `EXULU_USE_LITELLM`, `TTS_MODEL`, or `TTS_VOICE` are not set.

example.text: Welcome to the Intelligence Management Platform.

400.description: Missing or empty `text`, or text exceeds 4,000 characters.

503.description: Text-to-speech not enabled on this deployment, or the speech service is not yet ready.

post.description: Generates one or more images from a text prompt using an image-generation model from `config.litellm.yaml`. Generated images are uploaded to S3 under the session's prefix and a presigned URL is returned for each. Requires write access to the session. Returns 503 when LiteLLM, S3, or image-generation models are not configured.

sessionId.description: Session to associate the generated images with.

toolCallId.description: Tool call ID linking this generation to a specific tool invocation.

model.description: Model name as listed in `config.litellm.yaml` with `model_info.type: image_generation`.

prompt.description: Text prompt to generate images from.

n.description: Number of images to generate. Must not exceed the model's `max_n` limit.

size.description: Image dimensions (e.g. `1024x1024`). Must be a value supported by the chosen model.

quality.description: Generation quality level (e.g. `standard`, `hd`). Must be supported by the chosen model.

styleId.description: Optional ID of a saved style (`platform_configurations` row). Its markdown content is appended to the prompt.

400.description: Missing required fields, unknown model, invalid `n`/`size`/`quality`, or style not found.

403.description: Caller lacks write access to the session.

503.description: Image generation not enabled on this deployment or service not ready.

post.description: Edits one or more reference images using a text prompt and uploads the results to S3. Reference image keys must belong to the calling user's S3 folder or the session's images prefix — the backend enforces this with a prefix check. An optional mask image key may be provided for inpainting. The chosen model must support editing (`supports_edit: true` in `config.litellm.yaml`).

referenceImageKeys.description: S3 keys of the source images. Must belong to the session or calling user's prefix.

maskKey.description: Optional S3 key of a mask image for inpainting.

400.description: Missing fields, model does not support editing, or invalid parameters.

403.description: Caller lacks write access to the session or a reference/mask key is inaccessible.

503.description: Image generation not enabled or service not ready.

post.description: Marks one or more generated images as selected and appends a system message to the session so the agent sees the selection on its next turn. Each selection identifies a `generationId` and an `imageKey` from within that generation. The image key must be part of the referenced generation row. Requires write access to the session.

imageKey.description: S3 key of the specific image to select.

200.description: Selection recorded and system message appended.

400.description: Missing fields or `imageKey` not part of the referenced generation.

403.description: Caller lacks write access to the session.

404.description: Session not found, or generation ID not found in this tool call.

503.description: Image routes not enabled on this deployment.

get.description: Returns all image generation records for a given session and tool call, ordered oldest first. Includes presigned URLs for all generated images and reference images. Requires read access to the session.

parameters.name: toolCallId
parameters.description: Tool call ID to filter generations by.

403.description: Caller lacks read access to the session.

503.description: Image routes not enabled on this deployment.

get.description: Returns the global budget settings stored in Postgres, including the default per-user budget configuration and the UI display preferences. Requires `super_admin` or a role with `budget_management` read or write access.

403.description: Budget management access required.

put.description: Persists global budget settings. Enables or disables the default per-user budget, sets the global limit and reset period, and controls whether the budget indicator is shown in the chat UI. Requires `super_admin` or `budget_management` write.

max_budget.description: Maximum spend in USD. Required when `enabled` is true.

403.description: Budget management write access required.

get.description: Returns the calling user's current budget view — spent amount, limit, and reset date — for the in-chat budget indicator. Returns `null` when `show_user_budget_in_chat` is disabled or the user has no active budget. Any authenticated user may call this endpoint.

put.description: Creates or updates LiteLLM tag budgets for multiple entities of the same type in a single call. Each entity ID is mapped to a tag (`{entityType}_id_{entityId}`) and upserted via the LiteLLM admin API. Results include per-entity success/error status. Requires `super_admin` or `budget_management` write.

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Entity type to budget. One of `user`, `role`, `team`, `project`, `agent`, `routine`.

budget_reset_at.description: ISO UTC calendar boundary for the next reset. Passed to LiteLLM via `/budget/update`.

400.description: Invalid entity type, empty `entityIds`, or invalid budget body.

403.description: Budget management write access required.

put.description: Creates or updates the LiteLLM tag budget for a single entity. The tag is `{entityType}_id_{entityId}`. On success, returns the live budget info fetched from LiteLLM. Requires `super_admin` or `budget_management` write.

400.description: Invalid entity type or budget body.

403.description: Budget management write access required.

delete.description: Removes the LiteLLM tag budget for a single entity and invalidates the local cache. Returns 204 on success. Requires `super_admin` or `budget_management` write.

403.description: Budget management write access required.

get.description: Queries LiteLLM's `/tag/daily/activity` endpoint, projects the response into a stable shape, and returns daily spend/token breakdowns with per-tag and per-model aggregates. The `tag_prefix` parameter is an IMP convenience: it resolves all tags matching the prefix via `/tag/list` before forwarding to LiteLLM, ensuring the full window is covered regardless of page size. Restricted to `super_admin`.

parameters.name: tag_prefix
parameters.description: Resolves all LiteLLM tags matching this prefix (e.g. `user_id_`, `agent_id_`) and passes them to the query.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated explicit tag list. When combined with `tag_prefix`, returns the intersection.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Filter to a specific LiteLLM model name.

parameters.name: exclude_team_tags
parameters.description: Set `true` to exclude `team_*` tags from the breakdown.

403.description: Super admin access required.

get.description: Returns a zip containing the `imp-skills` bootstrap skill — `SKILL.md`, `references/clients.json`, and `scripts/imp` (executable). This endpoint is public (no authentication required) so any agent client can self-install it without a logged-in session.
Returns all skills the caller can read, filtered by RBAC. Optionally filter by tag. The response is the agent-facing catalog shape (name, description, tags, current_version, updated_at).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Return only skills whose `tags` array contains this value.

get.description: Streams all files for the requested version as a `.skill` zip with a single wrapper folder (`{name}/`) so the archive round-trips cleanly through the uploader. Defaults to `current_version` when `version` is omitted or `latest`. Requires read access to the skill.

403.description: No read access to the skill.

get.description: Returns metadata for a single skill (name, description, tags, current_version, history). Requires read access to the skill.

403.description: No read access.

post.description: Publishes a skill bundle from an agent. If the name does not exist, creates a new skill at v1 and requires `?visibility=public|private`. If the name exists and the caller has write access, appends a new version. Returns 403 when the name exists but the caller lacks write access; returns 409 when the name exists but the caller cannot even read it (existence is not revealed). The request body must be raw zip/`.skill` bytes.

parameters.name: visibility
parameters.description: Required for new skills. `public` or `private`. Ignored when updating an existing skill.

created.description: True when a new skill row was created.

400.description: Empty body, missing `visibility`, or bundle validation error.

403.description: Skill exists but caller lacks write access.

409.description: Name unavailable (exists but caller cannot read it).

post.description: Called immediately after a skill row is created via GraphQL. Writes a starter `SKILL.md` to S3 and sets `s3folder`, `current_version`, and `history` on the skill row. Returns the S3 key of the created file.

post.summary: Get a presigned URL for staging a skill bundle
post.description: Returns a presigned PUT URL targeting a per-user staging area in S3. After the upload completes, call `/skills/{skillId}/init-from-upload` to extract the bundle. Accepts `.zip`, `.md`, or `.skill` extensions.

400.description: Invalid extension or missing content type.

post.description: Fetches a staged bundle from S3, validates it (SKILL.md presence, path safety, size and count caps), and extracts it to `skills/{skillId}/v1/`. Updates the skill row's `s3folder`, `current_version`, and `history`. The `stagingKey` must belong to the authenticated user's staging prefix; the call fails with 403 otherwise. On extraction failure the skill row is deleted so the user can retry.

stagingKey.description: Key returned by `upload-sign`. Must start with `user_{id}/skills/_staging/`.

400.description: Missing fields or bundle validation error.

403.description: Staging key does not belong to the authenticated user.

get.description: Lists all files in a skill version and returns a virtual folder tree reconstructed from the flat S3 listing. Defaults to `current_version` when `version` is not supplied.

get.summary: Download a skill version as a zip
get.description: Bundles every file in the requested skill version into a zip. Pass `?format=skill` to produce a `.skill` archive with a wrapper folder (`{name}/`) for round-tripping through the uploader. Defaults to the current version.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Set to `skill` to produce a `.skill` archive.

post.summary: Get a presigned URL for a skill file
post.description: Returns a presigned PUT URL for uploading a single file at an exact path within the skill's current version. The `filePath` is sanitised (leading slashes stripped, path traversal blocked) before the S3 key is constructed.

filePath.description: Relative path within the skill version (e.g. `scripts/analyze.py`).

get.description: Returns a presigned download URL for the specified S3 key. For small text files (≤ 200 KB, recognised extensions like `.md`, `.py`, `.json`) also returns the raw content inline to avoid a second round trip. The key must start with `skills/{skillId}/`.

200.description: Presigned URL and optional inline content.

content.description: Raw text content (only for small text files).

403.description: Key does not belong to this skill.

delete.summary: Delete a skill file or folder
delete.description: Deletes a single file (pass `?key=`) or all files under a prefix (pass `?prefix=`). Both must start with `skills/{skillId}/`; otherwise a 403 is returned.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Full S3 key of a single file to delete.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: S3 key prefix — all matching objects are deleted.

403.description: Key/prefix does not belong to this skill.

post.description: Copies all files in `current_version` into a new version slot, then advances `current_version`. Editing then happens in the new slot while prior versions remain immutable. Fails with 400 if the current version has no files.

label.description: Human-readable label for the history entry.

200.description: New version number and file count.

post.description: Copies `sourceKey` to a new path within the current version and deletes the original — effectively a rename or move. `destPath` is sanitised before use. `sourceKey` must start with `skills/{skillId}/`.

sourceKey.description: Full S3 key of the file to move.

destPath.description: New relative path within the current version.

403.description: Source key does not belong to this skill.

get.description: Compares two versions of a skill and returns per-file status (`added`, `removed`, `modified`). Unchanged files are filtered out of the response. For modified text files (≤ 500 KB total) also returns a unified diff string. Files with non-text extensions are listed as `modified` without a diff.

post.summary: Get a presigned single-part PUT URL
post.description: Returns a presigned S3 PUT URL for uploading a file directly from the browser. Generates a UUID-prefixed key under `user_{id}/` (or `global/` when the `global` header is set). Used by the Uppy AwsS3 plugin. Accepts the standard API key or session JWT.

parameters.name: global
parameters.description: Set to any truthy value to upload under `global/` instead of `user_{id}/`.

post.description: Creates an S3 multipart upload and returns the `uploadId` and full key. The full key (including user/global prefix and any S3 general prefix) must be passed back on all subsequent part-signing and completion calls.

metadata.description: Optional S3 metadata. Non-ASCII characters are URL-encoded automatically.

get.description: Returns a presigned URL for uploading a single part. `partNumber` must be an integer between 1 and 10,000. The `key` query parameter must be the full key returned by the multipart-create call.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Full S3 key returned by the multipart-create call.

400.description: Invalid part number or missing key.

get.description: Lists all parts already uploaded for a multipart upload. Handles S3 pagination automatically.

delete.description: Aborts the multipart upload and removes any already-uploaded parts from S3.

post.description: Sends the CompleteMultipartUpload command to S3 with the list of part ETags. The `parts` array must contain `{ PartNumber, ETag }` objects for every uploaded part.

get.description: Lists objects under the calling user's S3 prefix (or `global/` when the `global` header is set). Supports a `search` query for substring filtering and a `continuationToken` for pagination. Returns up to 9 objects per page when not searching. Also accepts the `internal-key` header (set to `INTERNAL_SECRET`) for server-to-server calls.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring to filter object keys by (case-insensitive, scans all pages).

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: S3 continuation token for the next page.

200.description: S3 list response with `Contents` keys prefixed by bucket name.

get.description: Returns a presigned GET URL for an S3 object. The `key` must include the bucket as the first path segment (format returned by `/s3/list`). Access is restricted to the owner's prefix, super admins, and API-type users. Also accepts the `internal-key` header (set to `INTERNAL_SECRET`) for server-to-server calls.

405.description: Caller is not permitted to access the requested key.

get.description: Returns temporary AWS STS credentials (via `GetFederationToken`) that give the holder `s3:PutObject` permission on the configured bucket. The token is cached by the browser for `expiresIn` seconds. Used by the Uppy AwsS3 plugin for direct multipart uploads.

delete.description: Deletes a single object from S3. The `key` must include the bucket as the first segment. Access is restricted to the owner's prefix, super admins, and API-type users. Also accepts the `internal-key` header (set to `INTERNAL_SECRET`) for server-to-server calls.

405.description: Caller is not permitted to delete the requested key.

get.description: Returns a ZIP archive containing every personal-data record held for the target user: `user_data.json` (account row with password/API-key hashes stripped), `sessions.json` (chat sessions with messages inlined), `feedback.json`, `prompt_favorites.json`, and `tracking.json`. Callers must be `super_admin`. The target user may also export their own data (self-export is allowed).

403.description: Super admin access required.

delete.description: Hard-deletes the target user and all personally identifiable data in a single database transaction: messages, sessions, feedback, prompt_favorites, tracking, RBAC entries, and the users row. After the transaction commits, S3 objects under `user_{id}/` are deleted best-effort (failure is logged but does not fail the request). Callers must be `super_admin`. Admins cannot delete their own account (`allowSelf: false`).

403.description: Super admin required, or caller attempted self-delete.

get.summary: List share links for a file
get.description: Returns all share links created by the calling user for a given S3 key. The `s3key` is normalised (bucket stripped if present) before querying.

parameters.name: s3key
parameters.description: S3 key of the file (as returned by `/s3/list`).

post.description: Creates a named share link for an S3 object. `auth_mode` controls access: `public` (share name is the capability, no further auth), `password` (caller supplies a password hashed with bcrypt), `regular` (standard IMP RBAC applies). For `regular` shares, pass `rbac` to configure visibility. Returns 409 when the name is already taken.

name.description: URL-safe slug for the share link.

400.description: Validation error (invalid name, missing password, etc.).

delete.description: Removes the share link and any associated RBAC entries. Only the creator may delete their own share links.

403.description: Caller is not the creator.

get.description: Returns low-sensitivity metadata for a share link — `auth_mode`, `expires_at`, `filename`, `content_type`, and `is_html` — without revealing the password hash or file bytes. Public (no authentication required); the share name is the capability.

Serves the raw file bytes from S3. Authentication depends on `auth_mode`: `public` — no auth; `password` — pass the password in `x-share-password`; `regular` — standard IMP API key or bearer JWT, RBAC-checked. Returns 410 when the link has expired.

403.description: RBAC check failed for `regular` share.
